scheme_name: Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008
other_conditions: Micro and Small Enterprises must be registered with the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Medium and large units must be approved by the High‑Powered Coordination Committee after 1 April 2008
Units must employ at least 80% local manpower (contract/temporary/daily wage employees are excluded)
Units must fall under “Green”, “Orange”, or the specified “Orange” categories
Proprietors, partners, promoters, directors or their relatives are not counted as employees for subsidy claims
Preference is given to women‑owned proprietary concerns (100% ownership) and partnership firms with at least 51% women ownership and an additional partner not a husband, father, brother or son
benefits_summary: Provides up to 40% subsidy on capital and interest, including an additional 5% local employment subsidy and higher interest subsidy limits
